description: Generate reusable test assets from the actions recorded in this session. target: flow (Flow V2 YAML), pom (page objects), suite (POM suite under .swipium/, compiled to flows, replay-gated), testcases (TC catalog), appium (WebdriverIO or Python project; can bootstrap from projectRoot). mode:"plan" previews. Durable repo suite: qa_suite_generate.

bootstrap.description: appium: record actions first when none exist.

candidateOnly.description: appium: brittle locators do not fail validation.

compile.description: suite: compile to runnable Flow V2 (default true).

integrateIntoProject.description: appium: write into the project (consent-gated, never overwrites).

name.description: Asset name (default from the app id).

replay.description: suite: replay gate (default dry_run; fresh_state needs stateProfile).

save.description: Write files (default: suite/appium true, others false).

name: qa_generate
title: Generate test assets from recorded actions
